tcs.feature: Publish DSR CF (live) → catalog detail page created (CATOV-001)

tcs.expected: EN: HTTP 200, final URL unchanged (no redirect); catalog name = content CF catalogTitle (e.g. 'QA190 PDF catalog'); <title> starts with the catalog name. JP: 200、リダイレクトなし、カタログ名一致。
